name: Meeting Recorder
description: Record a meeting (mic + system/video sound), live captions via Amazon Transcribe, timed screenshots; saved as a .htrans folder an agent can summarize.

params.description: AWS region used for Amazon Transcribe streaming (e.g. us-east-1).
params.description_zh: Amazon Transcribe 流式转写使用的 AWS 区域（如 us-east-1）。

params.description: Candidate languages for "auto" language mode, comma-separated Amazon Transcribe codes (e.g. zh-CN,en-US).
params.description_zh: 「自动」语言模式下的候选语言，用逗号分隔的 Amazon Transcribe 语言代码（如 zh-CN,en-US）。

secrets.description: AWS access key id. Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Access Key ID。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。

secrets.description: AWS secret access key. Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Secret Access Key。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。

secrets.description: AWS session token (only for temporary credentials). Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Session Token（仅临时凭证需要）。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。
